description: Describes one user-driven expansion change of a TmAccordionItem inside a TmAccordion — raised through TmAccordion.OnItemToggled for the clicked item and for every sibling the single mode closes implicitly (close notifications come first).

members.name: Key
members.description: The item's TmAccordionItem.Key, or null for a keyless (self-managed) item.

members.name: Expanded
members.description: The requested expansion state — false for an implicit sibling close in single mode.

members.name: Index
members.description: The item's index within the accordion (registration order — DOM order for a static item list; an item inserted conditionally later is appended).

usageExample:
<TmAccordion OnItemToggled="OnToggled">
    <TmAccordionItem Key="install" Title="Install">...</TmAccordionItem>
</TmAccordion>

@code {
    private void OnToggled(AccordionItemToggleEventArgs args)
    {
        // args.Key = "install", args.Expanded = true, args.Index = 0
    }
}
